channel.description: Latest articles from Santa Cruz Sentinel (santacruzsentinel.com)

item.title: Capitola receives federal funding for Bay Avenue improvements
item.description: Capitola has received $250,000 in federal funds to make improvements along Bay Avenue.

item.title: Scientists change how El Niño is labeled to keep up with spike in temperature
item.description: El Niños tend to increase global temperatures and La Niñas depress the long-term rise.

item.title: Trump seethes over Supreme Court justices who opposed him on tariffs, especially those he appointed
item.description: Legal opposition to the tariffs crossed political lines.

item.title: Justice Department swiftly fires lawyer chosen as top federal prosecutor for Virginia office
item.description: James Hundley was fired via social media Friday shortly after he was chosen by judges.

item.title: Macklin Celebrini chases Olympic gold, and Sharks history, in game vs. U.S.
item.description: Canada faces the United States in men's hockey gold medal game at Milan Cortina Olympics

item.title: Deadly California avalanche highlights inherent risks in the backcountry
item.description: The recovery of skiers killed in the deadliest U.S. avalanche in almost 45 years is dragging out because of what experts say is a prime rule for rescuers: Don’t make yourself a victim.

item.title: Officials turn to controlled explosions to recover bodies of California avalanche victims
item.description: Officials worked to lower the risks of more deadly slides Friday by setting off controlled explosions in the area where an avalanche struck in California’s Sierra Nevada so crews could safely recover the bodies of the people killed.

item.title: Stephen Kessler | The state of the union is incredible
item.description: In this week's column, Stephen Kessler does his best Donald Trump impression to give a sneak preview of what we might be able to expect from next week's State of the Union address.

item.title: McGuire enters special election to serve out late Rep. LaMalfa’s unfinished term
item.description: With the race on late Rep. Doug LaMalfa’s former turf, rather than in the Democrat-friendly, post-Prop. 50 1st Congressional District, state Sen. Mike McGuire will be the underdog.

item.title: Cabrillo’s playoff-bound basketball team tops Foothill, locks up third place | Local Roundup
item.description: Sophomores Skylarr Redwood and Charlie Kosta set the tone early on offense, and the playoff-bound Cabrillo College men's basketball team took care of business with its 77-65 win over visiting Foothill in the teams' regular-season finale on Friday.
